title: Chameleon holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M50 38 Q48 50 42 58" stroke="#A0D8EF" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="28" rx="12" ry="15" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="28" rx="12" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#FF9DB5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="23" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFB3C6"/>
  <polygon points="48,42 52,42 50,46" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  
  <!-- Chameleon tail (curled) -->
  <path d="M22 68 Q12 68 12 60 Q12 52 20 52 Q28 52 28 60" fill="none" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Chameleon body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="65" rx="20" ry="12" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="63" rx="18" ry="9" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="68" r="2" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="64" r="1.8" fill="#388E3C"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="67" r="1.5" fill="#388E3C"/>
  
  <!-- Back ridge -->
  <path d="M28 56 Q34 52 40 55 Q46 52 52 56" fill="none" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Chameleon head -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="56" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  
  <!-- Head casque (crest) -->
  <path d="M60 50 Q64 44 70 48 Q67 50 65 52" fill="#388E3C"/>
  
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="55" r="4.5" fill="#C8E6C9"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#1B5E20"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="54" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M70 60 Q73 61 74 60" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Front arm holding string -->
  <path d="M54 70 Q48 72 44 60" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Hand gripping -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="59" r="3" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  
  <!-- Other front arm -->
  <path d="M58 72 Q60 76 56 78" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Back leg -->
  <path d="M30 74 Q28 80 24 82" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="23" cy="83" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  
  <!-- Front leg -->
  <path d="M48 74 Q46 80 42 82" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="83" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="66" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
